mechanism: Efavirenz induces CYP2C9 and CYP3A4, increasing isoniazid metabolism and reducing its plasma concentrations, while isoniazid may inhibit efavirenz metabolism, potentially increasing efavirenz levels and CNS toxicity risk.
action: Monitor isoniazid and efavirenz therapeutic levels; consider isoniazid dose adjustment or therapeutic drug monitoring; assess for efavirenz neurotoxicity symptoms (dizziness, impaired concentration, hallucinations).
